Proposition
[rigidity of expanding breathers] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Proposition 8.11\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals An expanding breather is a gradient expanding soliton.
Proof

↗ cor:kl-rescaled-invariant-rigidity-at-constant-rescaled-lambda ↗ prop:kl-rescaled-invariant-monotonicity-rescaled-lambda-invariant \sketch Scale and diffeomorphism invariance give $\bar\lambda (t_2)=\bar\lambda (t_1)$. Since $V(t_2)>V(t_1)$, (24) implies $\bar\lambda <0$ somewhere; monotonicity then makes it a negative constant, so apply Corollary 26.
